inheritance: every descendant inherits base_setup_id, primary_family_id and split verbatim; a train-derived setup can never become a validation or test setup

perturbation.acceptance_stack: stratego.setups.contracts.validate_perturbation — engine inventory/legality, Flag cell fixed, canonical Hamming in [2, 12], every required family clause satisfied and every forbidden clause failed, initial mobility present
perturbation.construction_note: operators are proposal rules only; they are never consulted during acceptance, and a descendant is accepted solely by the frozen validator
perturbation.identity: the descendant is a pure function of (base_setup_id, sampler_version, perturbation_seed); the operator mix and the retry budget are frozen constants of this version, and no caller-configurable input can change the result

operators.description: exchange two different piece types inside one canonical rank; every per-rank trait is preserved exactly, so only adjacency, file-spread and Flag-zone traits can move
operators.name: within_rank_swap

operators.description: exchange two different piece types across canonical ranks; the only proposal that moves a piece between ranks and therefore the one that expands rank-dimension support
operators.name: cross_rank_swap

operators.description: relocate a Bomb into or out of the Flag's Chebyshev-2 zone, varying the fortress wall without moving the Flag
operators.name: fortress_variation

operators.description: relocate a Bomb between cells at Manhattan distance >= 4 from the Flag, varying a false fortress or lane block far from the real Flag
operators.name: decoy_variation

operators.description: exchange a Scout with a non-Scout piece
operators.name: scout_relocation

operators.description: exchange a Miner with a non-Miner piece
operators.name: miner_relocation

operators.description: exchange a combat-rank >= 7 piece with a piece below that threshold, varying where the heavies stand
operators.name: high_rank_relocation

perturbation.seed_encoding_rule: perturbation_seed = (raw_seed << 3) | (swap_count - 1); low bits 0..5 encode swap counts 1..6, low bits 6 and 7 are invalid; swap_count is derived by decoding, never an independent input

perturbation_identity: the descendant is a pure function of (base_setup_id, sampler_version, perturbation_seed); the seed is the seed_encoding_v1 composite carrying swap count and raw randomness, the retry budget is the setup_perturbation_v1 version constant, and no profile or caller input can change the result once the seed is emitted
profile_freeze_owner: Agent 6 makes the final sampler-profile freeze

neutral_v1.base_selection: uniform over the family's base indices inside the requested split
neutral_v1.name: neutral_v1
neutral_v1.perturbation_execution: profile-independent: the profile chooses whether to perturb and encodes the intensity into the perturbation seed; the descendant is then a pure function of (base_setup_id, sampler_version, perturbation_seed)
neutral_v1.rationale: uniform family, uniform base within split, fair reflection coin, fair perturbation coin and a uniform intensity mix over the frozen Hamming window; no branch is weighted by any structural or strength argument, so the default asserts nothing Agent 6 has not frozen

perturbation_only_v1.base_selection: uniform over the family's base indices inside the requested split
perturbation_only_v1.name: perturbation_only_v1
perturbation_only_v1.perturbation_execution: profile-independent: the profile chooses whether to perturb and encodes the intensity into the perturbation seed; the descendant is then a pure function of (base_setup_id, sampler_version, perturbation_seed)
perturbation_only_v1.rationale: acceptance instrument: exercises the perturbed path only

reflection_only_v1.base_selection: uniform over the family's base indices inside the requested split
reflection_only_v1.name: reflection_only_v1
reflection_only_v1.perturbation_execution: profile-independent: the profile chooses whether to perturb and encodes the intensity into the perturbation seed; the descendant is then a pure function of (base_setup_id, sampler_version, perturbation_seed)
reflection_only_v1.rationale: acceptance instrument: exercises the unperturbed path only

derived_fields.perturbation_max_attempts: the setup_perturbation_v1 version constant; rebuild rejects a record whose value disagrees with it
derived_fields.perturbation_swap_count: decoded from perturbation_seed; rebuild rejects a record whose value disagrees with the encoding
derived_fields.sampler_profile: sampler decision metadata only; cannot alter reconstruction once the perturbation seed is fixed

provenance_schema.prohibited: no game outcome, win rate, Elo, value, policy or strength field may appear; provenance is training/debug metadata and must not cross the observer-safe model boundary

sampling_order: base (uniform over the family's bases inside the split)
perturbation intensity (profile weights over swap counts 1..6)
intensity + raw randomness encoded into one perturbation seed
stream_derivation: random.Random(derive_stream_seed('setup_sampler_v1:<field>', profile, split, seed)); one domain-separated stream per decision; no mutable global RNG state is consumed

stress_corpus.note: an acceptance instrument that deliberately balances every branch; not the Phase 8 default profile
